**Technical Stack**
* AI & ML: Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Computer Vision, Object Detection, Image Classification, OCR, Multimodal AI (LLAVA), Model Training, NLP.
* Frontend: React, React Native, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, GSAP, Framer Motion.
* Backend & APIs: Node.js, Express.js, Python, Flask, FastAPI, REST APIs, WebSockets, SSR, Microservices.
* Databases & Cloud: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL, NGINX, Docker, CI/CD, Git, Linux.
* Optimization: Web Performance Optimization, Technical SEO.

**Professional Experience**
* Full Stack Developer at Thakur Educational Group (Jan 2025 - Apr 2025): Engineered the official TGBS Mumbai website using SSR with Express.js. Developed a custom role-based CMS and hardened server infrastructure using NGINX.
* Full Stack Developer at GRAIN Analytics (May 2024 - Jul 2024): Built an enterprise operations dashboard using React and Python. Integrated Google APIs and developed an LLM-powered assistant for labor scheduling queries.
* AI/ML Intern at TRAAIN Circle Pvt. Ltd. (Dec 2023 - Apr 2024): Built "Mishraji", a GPT-4 conversational assistant. Trained CV models for retail analytics and implemented custom voice systems using Azure Cognitive Services.
* Entrepreneurship: Currently building out the infrastructure and service offerings for ZeroShot Media, an upcoming digital marketing and web agency.

**Education**
* Thakur College of Engineering and Technology (2021 - 2024): B.E. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.
* Sathaye College (2019 - 2021): HSC in Science.
